integrity: All mathematical identities are established analytically. Exact symbolic algebra and finite rational tests are supplementary checks, not universal computational certification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns k >= 3, the Markov-aligned outer slope 1/(k-1), stationary absolutely continuous initialization, and one natural sign observable. It is not a classification of all invariant probabilities or parameter slopes; no independent validation has been performed. The original 2021 paper was accessible only as a publisher preview, so publication-priority comparison is incomplete.
title: Exact sign memory and vanishing diffusion in a fixed-point-free four-branch family
